subject: EVALUATE directive
notes: Descriptive rule (cite.py --check 7.3.13.3 "operand-1 refers to literal-1, arithmetic-expression-1, or boolean-expression-1 in format 1 and to the TRUE keyword in format 2" OK). The EVALUATE arm maps operand-1 to Frame.TruthForm (the TRUE keyword) or Frame.Subject (a compileTimeOperand: literal / arithmeticExpression / booleanExpression, CobolExpressions.g4 compileTimeOperand); the WHEN arm maps operand-2 to a cce (TruthForm) or MatchWhen's lo operand, operand-3 to SplitRange's hi. directive_expressions.cob exercises Format 1 with operand-2 THROUGH operand-3 with spec-derived expected output (MID). || editions (adjudicator): 2002, 2014, 2023 (the §7.3 compiler-directive facility, absent from 1985; Annex E E.2 item 8 shows the EVALUATE directive already in the previous standard)
